finalText:
---

## Diagnosis: Egress Traffic Blocked by NetworkPolicy

**Root Cause:** NetworkPolicy `c077-deny-egress` in namespace `siclaw-eval-yye-20260602` explicitly denies all egress traffic from pods labeled `app: c077-client`. Since both DNS resolution (UDP/53 to CoreDNS) and service connectivity (TCP/80 to cluster IP) require egress, the client cannot resolve or reach the service.

**Concrete Evidence:**

| Finding | Evidence |
|---------|----------|
| Matching NetworkPolicy | `networkpolicy/c077-deny-egress` with `spec.podSelector.matchLabels.app: c077-client` |
| Policy type | `spec.policyTypes: ["Egress"]` |
| Deny rules | Empty `egress: []` and `ingress: []` arrays — implicitly denies all egress |
| Client labels | `{"app":"c077-client","siclaw.ai/eval-case":"c077"}` — matches policy selector |
| Server pod status | `c077-server` Running, IP `172.16.36.216` — backend is healthy |
| Service configuration | Selector `app: c077-server`, clusterIP `172.17.152.83`, port `80→8080` — correctly configured |
| DNS configuration | `dnsPolicy: ClusterFirst` — standard; not the cause |

**Impact/Scope:** Single pod (`c077-client`) in namespace `siclaw-eval-yye-20260602`. Both DNS resolution and TCP connections to any destination are blocked.

**Confidence:** High — the NetworkPolicy label selector exactly matches the client pod labels and denies all egress.

**Safe Remediation:**
1. Delete the restrictive policy: `kubectl delete networkpolicy c077-deny-egress -n siclaw-eval-yye-20260602`
2. Or modify it to allow necessary egress (DNS to CoreDNS on UDP/53, HTTP to service on TCP/80)
